race.comment: MEET THE PRINCE (11) had a good run at Manangatang 9 days ago and stuck on bravely for second by a neck as the favourite. The blinkers are off for his first test over ground, and he can measure up again. MUSICAL JOURNEY (12) did not help himself by making a slow start at Kilmore 3 weeks ago, and he never recovered. The key here is the step up from 1450m to 2100m, and he can bounce straight back into the money here. UNDER CONTROL (9) was runner-up here in her penultimate start, and then had no luck in a tougher field at Ballarat nearly 3 weeks ago. She is worth another chance at decent odds. JUST BASIL (3) ruined his chances with a slow start at Tatura, and his second at Sale prior is the guide to use. Don't drop him.
